findings.evidenceJa: なにやってるかばかちーーーーーーん
findings.governingReading: What are you doing, you idiooooot!
findings.explanation: Taiga’s accusation about the player’s action is reduced to a contextless insult.

findings.highlight: someone would see this Tiger Dojo
findings.evidenceJa: このタイガー道場を見る兵がおろうとは
findings.governingReading: that there should be a soldier who lives to see this Tiger Dojo
findings.explanation: The mock-martial address to the failed player as a soldier disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 最後の決着をつけちゃいなさーい
findings.governingReading: go settle the final confrontation already
findings.explanation: The route-closing confrontation is reduced to a generic match.

findings.governingReading: a little heartwarming or useful “Fate” story
findings.explanation: Illya’s playful segment title is replaced by a functional description.

findings.highlight: There’s two that you don’t have to do.
findings.evidenceJa: うち二つばかり選ばなくていい
findings.governingReading: among them are about two you need not choose
findings.explanation: The hedge around the deliberately inconsistent route-hint count becomes an exact total.

findings.highlight: if you’re too occupied with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーにかまけてると
findings.governingReading: if you spend all your time fussing over Saber
findings.explanation: Rin’s dismissively comic phrasing is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 押忍、ありがとうございましたー！
findings.explanation: Illya’s exaggerated martial-polite thanks loses part of its performative register.

findings.highlight: please start over from the 3rd day if you have some time
findings.evidenceJa: 余裕があったら三日目からやり直してみてねー
findings.governingReading: if you have the time, try starting over from day three
findings.explanation: A light optional suggestion becomes a direct request.
